title: Ukuphindaphinda Kwenkohliso
intro: Isibopho sobuhlobo savivinywa ngokukhukhumala komona. Kwaqalwa icebo eliyimfihlo, laqala uchungechunge lwezehlakalo ezazizothatha iminyaka futhi zidlule amabanga amade. Izenzo zaleli qembu zaholela ekuhlukaneni okukhulu nasekudabukeni, kodwa indaba ayizange iphele lapho. Yindaba yokukhohlisa, ukuzisola, kanye nokwembuleka kokugcina kwecebo laphezulu. Ungakwazi yini ukuhlukanisa ukuthi bangobani laba bantu abakhetha izinto ezifanayo ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane?
clues: Sasigcwele umona ngenxa yothando oluboniswa komunye wethu.
Ngenxa yomona wethu, sakha uzungu ndawonye futhi saphonsa umfowethu ebumnyameni bomthombo.
Ukuze sifihle isenzo sethu, sanikeza ubaba ingubo, egcotshwe igazi mbumbulu.
Eminyakeni eminingi kamuva, indlala enkulu yasiphoqa ukuba siye eGibhithe siyofuna ukudla.
Lapho, seza phambi kombusi onamandla, thina esingamazi, owayeyiso kanye isizukulwane sakithi esasimonile.
Isivivinyo sethu sokugcina kwakuwukuletha umfowethu omncane, uBinyamin, okwaholela ekwambulweni kwesikhathi sethu esidlule kanye nobaba wethu enguMprofethi uYa'qub.

outcome.label: Waba yini umphumela wokugcina wendaba yethu?
options: Sathethelelwa futhi sahlangana kabusha nomndeni wethu
outcome.answer: Sathethelelwa futhi sahlangana kabusha nomndeni wethu

arabic: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَـٰطِـِٔينَ
verse: They said, "By Allāh, certainly has Allāh preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners." (12:91)
